messages:
Asha: quick async standup — what I did: pushed kernel slot allocation fix (PR #4923) to reduce slot steal. observed ~8% p95 improvement in microburst bench.

Carlos: nice. can you drop the PR link? i want to review today.

Asha: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4923 — tests + bench logs in the PR. bench command i ran: `scripts/bench_microburst.sh --iters 200 --seq 2048`. p95 went from ~134ms -> ~124ms.

Ivy: ran kv cache smoke on canary — saw one ttl eviction spike around 03:12 UTC that lines up w/ the prefetch race you mentioned. logs excerpt: ```kv_cache evict shard=3 keys=1200 ttl_ms=5 err=null``` Might be race between warmup and eviction.

Dave: i'll take the repro harness task. assigning myself to task #4926. quick heads up — can only pick it up after lunch (~17:00 PT).

Hana: FYI ops-bot shows canary deploy finished: "canary/runtime:v2026.3" rolled at 6143211800. no page alerts initially.

ops-bot: deploy finished: canary/runtime:v2026.3 — 3 pods healthy, 1 pod restarted (OOM) — investigating.

Carlos: OOM on canary — any logs? could the kernel change increase memory for kv prefetch?

Asha: saw the OOM too. tail shows `OutOfMemoryError` in slot-allocator right after warmup. i'm adding a soft memory cap in the kernel worker and will push a quick patch.

Ivy: suggestion: reduce prefetch batch size 256 -> 192 on canary to lower mem pressure before we have the cap. i'll open a tiny PR for config override.

Dave: ack. i'll run smokebench after the patch and post results here.

Asha: thanks. blocking until repro harness run + canary patch merged. ping me for pairing if needed.

Carlos: i'll review #4923 now.

Hana: adding a quick sync slot at 18:30 PT on the calendar if we need to pair.

ops-bot: alert cleared for canary OOM at 6143213500.

Dave: smokebench done after Ivy's tweak — p95 stable at ~127ms, no OOMs. summary: `bench: p95=127ms p50=34ms tokens=1.2M`. uploading full artifacts to #eng-runtime-artifacts.

Asha: awesome, unblocked for me — i'll continue rollout to small-batch canary and watch eviction metrics.

Carlos: merged #4923, left a small comment about a logging line. :thumbsup: 

Ivy: opened follow-up #4930 to capture eviction telemetry + longer duration runs.

Asha: thanks everyone — will report back after the small-batch rollout (tentative at 20:00 PT).
